message:
Running command: bash -lc 'python3 - <<"PY"
from pathlib import Path
# create fuzz input: 4 opts + 4 alloc + url string + entity string in xml fuzzer format
for name, doc in {
 "ascii": b"<a/>",
 "colon_bad": b"<a::/>",
 "ff_start": b"<\xff/>",
 "ff_after": b"<a\xff/>",
 "c0_after": b"<a\xc0/>",
 "pubid_ff": b"<!DOCTYPE a PUBLIC \"\xff\" \"x\"><a/>",
 "att_ff": b"<a \xff=\"1\"/>",
 "name_nonascii": "<\u037f/>".encode(),
}.items():
    data=b"\0\0\0\0\0\0\0\0doc.xml\\\n"+doc+b"\\\n"
    Path(f"/tmp/{name}.fuzz").write_bytes(data)
    Path(f"/tmp/{name}.xml").write_bytes(doc)
PY
for f in /tmp/*.fuzz; do echo ===$f===; ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:abort_on_error=0 /tmp/xml_fuzz_run $f >/tmp/out 2>&1; rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ] || grep -q "ERROR: AddressSanitizer" /tmp/out; then echo rc=$rc; head -60 /tmp/out; fi; done'
